title: Prove exact extreme-rank BIT header densities
body:
## Summary

A scoped counting proof with a finite certificate gives the exact good-header fractions for rank-one and corank-one BIT projectors, in every dimension m >= 2 over every finite field of order q. The rank-one bad fraction is strictly below 2/q. Equal conjugation fibers and complete prime-power header packets preserve these fractions.

```text
T = q^(m-1)(q^m-1)/(q-1)
good rank-one projectors   = q^(m-2)((q-1)q^(m-1)+1)
good corank-one projectors = (q^2-q+1)^(m-1)
good header fraction       = good projectors / T
```

This adds exact density formulas to the retained normalizer, beyond the earlier small-ring normal-form audit. It also states the complete-enumeration premise precisely: these are deterministic counts for a complete GL header domain. A wholly bad restricted low class and all its high lifts show why the fraction cannot be transferred to arbitrary header subsets. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

Only `research/projector-header-density/` is added. The scientific baseline is canonical main `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority revision 7. `SOURCES.json` pins the retained `selected-bit-recursive-closure` normalizer and proof. `TASK.json` explicitly changes the current card's scope from a #4100 proof audit to this new counting theorem.

## Evidence and reproduction

Before this contribution the extreme-rank density formula was not supplied by the retained normal-form argument. The new written proof uses rank-one factorizations and a weighted scalar-product walk. A generated receipt binds exact package bytes and both live inputs to the replay.

Local CPython 3.12 results:

- 951,417 matrix candidates give 2,162 nontrivial idempotents and 1,332 good packets.
- Complete scans enumerate 315,648 invertible headers. The actual retained normalizer agrees on 29,977 admission checks: complete small domains and both extreme ranks of GL3(F3), with a declared index-mod-97 sample at modulus 25.
- Canonical projector censuses cover dimensions through five, with a separate scalar-pair path check. Dropping zero coordinate products changes one checked count from 98 to 8; wrong reversal and final-minor-only controls reject. All 81 high lifts of the bad swap class reject.
- Both registered commands pass locally in 3.357 and 3.331 seconds, below their 180-second limits. These are check durations, not performance comparisons.
- `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` pass. The publication preflight checks all 11 package/input files and source history.
- The official committed export passes its integrity check. Both direct commands pass without Git, with all 12 exported files unchanged. Independent source-corruption, receipt-corruption and overwrite-refusal controls reject as expected.

From the repository root:

```sh
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/projector-header-density/verify.py
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/projector-header-density/verify.py
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/projector-header-density
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/projector-header-density --check-source-history
```

Expected scientific output: `PASS_PROJECTOR_HEADER_DENSITY {"good": 1332, "projectors": 2162}`. `RESULT.json` is generated, never hand-written; the optional `--write-receipt /new/external/path.json` command creates a fresh candidate outside the checkout.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The universal result is the written scoped proof. Finite replay and separate mathematical/code checking do not supply independent human or formal proof-kernel review. Executable finite-field coverage uses prime fields; extension-field execution is unrun. No GL64 enumeration, intermediate-rank density, complete selected request census, fallback repricing, physical recurrence, supplier admission or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. The complete selected cold replay was not run because no selected input changes.

## Open next questions

The package's intermediate-rank question now has a proposed answer in concurrent #4228. This PR does not audit that universal recurrence.

1. At one retained caller, bind complete equally weighted header packets and frozen-ancestor independence to the actual request stream.
2. Price every fallback child and restoration charge before substituting exact rates into an admitted bill. Physical supplier admission remains open.

## Related open work

- #4215 checks the good-packet normal-form identity. This contribution supplies a distinct all-dimension counting theorem; its independently enumerated 2,162 total / 1,332 good corpus agrees numerically with that PR's reported aggregate.
- #4194 uses rank-one idempotents for a different fixed bank-repair model. No density or call-count quantity is shared, so there is no overlapping number to compare.
- #4228 now proposes an exact all-rank recurrence, extending this package's endpoints. Substituting m=4, q=3 into its published formula agrees numerically with this receipt at both overlapping endpoints: 495/1080 good at rank one and 343/1080 at corank one. Its intermediate-rank proof is not checked here.
- Merged #3950 already supplies a rank-seven polynomial/caller bound and complete-header context. Its generic counting context is predecessor work; the exact extreme-rank formulas are the contribution here.

## CI notes

Hosted [run 39483788680](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39483788680) is green at exact head `3d793eade8de2ba49ec08f8d004c1b2f566a78e6`: `plan` passes in 2m26s and the package `replay` passes in 1m30s. Both scientific PASS markers appear in the hosted log, along with `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. The unchanged-input check succeeds. No check failed. Local metadata, both registered checks, publication/source-history preflight and both Git-free export replays also pass.

## Merge danger

Reversible isolated research package. Production sources, invoices and the selected record are unchanged.
